definition: The answer states a policy (window, fee, threshold, duration) that contradicts the policy text the agent just retrieved.
A tool is called with an argument that does not match what the customer said (wrong order id, wrong item, wrong reason).
The agent acts against an explicit customer preference or limit (contact channel, deadline, partial action).
The escalation policy requires a human (asked for a person, chargeback, legal threat) but the agent keeps going alone.
A tool returned an error or failure status but the agent told the customer the action succeeded.
